title: DevX Impact Framework: SDKs / Docs / Quickstarts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable framework to measure and drive impact for Developer Experience programs focused on SDKs, documentation, and quickstarts. The goal is to move beyond vanity metrics and establish leading indicators (time-to-first-call, starter-app retention, actionable feedback loop) tied to a quarterly OKR so product and eng can prioritize work that demonstrably reduces activation time and increases healthy usage. This ticket tracks the cross-functional initiative to define the framework, instrument the key signals, run a pilot across two SDK languages, and deliver a playbook and dashboard for ongoing tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Framework doc published in Confluence with definitions for leading and lagging metrics
Instrumentation plan implemented for starter apps and quickstarts in two SDKs (JavaScript, Python)
Dashboards populated with historical baseline for selected signals (TFTC, first-week retention, error surface rate)
Experiment plan for 2 feature changes (improved quickstart readme, smaller starter repo) drafted and scheduled
Playbook for handoff to DevX operations with runbook and monthly cadence established
milestones: 2026-02-14: Instrumentation spec and tracker events merged - complete
2026-03-12: Baseline dashboards live in Looker - in progress
2026-03-25: Run first experiment and collect two weeks of signal - planned
2026-04-20: Playbook + rollout to additional SDKs - planned
risks: Tracking gaps: some starter repos are not using unified telemetry and will require migration work
Attribution ambiguity between docs improvements and SDK changes making signal noisy
Limited eng capacity in March due to runtime release freeze; may delay integrations
Privacy/compliance: need to validate telemetry events with Security prior to shipping in Private deployments
actions: Finalize event schema and publish to devx-telemetry repo (ENG to implement)
Create lightweight instrumentation shim in starter repos to forward events to Looker pipeline
Coordinate with Docs team for canonical quickstart templates and update checklist
Run two A/B experiments: compressed starter repo vs full repo; concise README vs extended README
Weekly sync with stakeholders (Eng, Docs, DX enablement, Research) to review signals and unblock work
